item.title: Round money only with round_money
item.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

item.title: Exclude bool when validating integer fields
item.content: When validating integer fields such as quantity, reject bool explicitly (isinstance(x, bool)) before the int check, since True/False are ints in Python.

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`). Apply it to both the argument and `sub.started_at`.

item.title: Compute periods with timedelta floor division
item.content: Compute subscription period boundaries the same way as `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`: `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and `n = (at - start) // length`, then `start + n * length`.
